instruction: I share my amazon prime account with my roommates. I am having trouble logging in. Change its password to Zlp9tir and share it with them via phone text message.
notes: Since the supervisor cannot log in to Amazon, the password is changed through the reset flow: amazon.send_password_reset_code (no login needed) emails a code to the supervisor's Gmail; the agent logs into Gmail, finds the thread (show_inbox_threads with a query) and reads the code (show_thread), then calls amazon.reset_password with the new password Zlp9tir. Roommates are discovered with phone.search_contacts(relationship='roommate'); the number of roommates is unknown a priori, so two roommate objects are modeled (matching the 11-call reference); add more person/phone-number objects and goal conjuncts if search_contacts returns more. Each text must contain the new password (message-contains) and is only sent after the password is actually changed. supervisor-complete-task carries the goal entities (new password and both roommates) as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the problem goal; it takes no answer since the task asks no question. Plan length 11.

plan: (phone-send-text-message phone-roommate-1 message-new-amazon-password gmail-token roommate-1 roommate zlp9tir)
(phone-send-text-message phone-roommate-2 message-new-amazon-password gmail-token roommate-2 roommate zlp9tir)
